Har baar jab koi ad pe click karta hai
Har baar jab aapka ad dikhaya jata hai

q.en: In paid ads, what does CPA usually stand for?

A se F grades

mr: A ते F grades
1 ते 5 stars

exp.mr: Quality Score हा keyword-level diagnostic असून 1 ते 10 पर्यंत असतो. जास्त score म्हणजे तुमच्या जाहिराती व landing page searchers साठी अधिक relevant आहेत.

q.en: What does adding a negative keyword do in Google Ads?
q.hi: Google Ads mein negative keyword add karne se kya hota hai?
q.mr: Google Ads मध्ये negative keyword टाकल्याने काय होते?

en: Lowers your bid on that word
Shows your ad only for that word
Stops ads showing for searches with that term
Reports that word to Google as spam
hi: Us word pe aapki bid kam karta hai
Ad sirf usi word pe dikhata hai
Us term wali searches pe ads dikhna band karta hai
Us word ko Google ko spam report karta hai
mr: त्या शब्दावरची bid कमी करतो
जाहिरात फक्त त्या शब्दावर दाखवतो
तो term असलेल्या searches वर जाहिराती दाखवणे थांबवतो
तो शब्द Google कडे spam म्हणून report करतो

exp.en: Negative keywords block your ads from searches containing that term, e.g. adding 'free' or 'jobs' to stop wasted clicks.
exp.hi: Negative keywords aapke ads ko un searches se block karte hain jismein woh term ho, jaise 'free' ya 'jobs' add karke wasted clicks rokna.
exp.mr: Negative keywords तो term असलेल्या searches वर तुमच्या जाहिराती दिसू देत नाहीत, उदा. 'free' किंवा 'jobs' टाकून वाया जाणारे clicks थांबवणे.

exp.hi: Broad match aapke keyword se related searches pe bhi ad dikha sakta hai, bina exact words ke bhi, isliye reach sabse zyada. Exact sabse narrow hai.
exp.mr: Broad match तुमच्या keyword शी संबंधित searches वर, अगदी ते शब्द नसतानाही, जाहिरात दाखवू शकतो, म्हणून reach सर्वात जास्त. Exact सर्वात narrow आहे.

q.en: What is a sitelink asset (formerly sitelink extension) in Google Ads?
q.hi: Google Ads mein sitelink asset (pehle sitelink extension) kya hai?
q.mr: Google Ads मध्ये sitelink asset (पूर्वीचे sitelink extension) म्हणजे काय?

en: Extra links under your ad to specific website pages

Link jo sirf WhatsApp chat kholta hai
Shop location dikhane wala map pin

SEO साठी Google ने दिलेली backlink
फक्त WhatsApp chat उघडणारी link
दुकानाचे location दाखवणारी map pin

exp.mr: Sitelinks search ad खाली extra clickable links जोडतात (उदा. 'Courses', 'Fees', 'Contact'), त्यामुळे जाहिरात मोठी व उपयोगी होते. Map pin हा location asset आहे.

q.en: In Google Ads, what is a 'conversion'?
q.hi: Google Ads mein 'conversion' kya hota hai?
q.mr: Google Ads मध्ये 'conversion' म्हणजे काय?

en: Any time your ad is shown on a page
A valuable action like a purchase, form fill or call
Changing a campaign from Search to Display
Converting your budget from ₹ to dollars
hi: Jab bhi ad kisi page pe show ho
Valuable action jaise purchase, form fill ya call
Campaign ko Search se Display mein badalna
Budget ko ₹ se dollars mein convert karna
mr: जाहिरात एखाद्या page वर दाखवली जाणे
purchase, form भरणे किंवा call सारखी मौल्यवान कृती
Campaign Search मधून Display मध्ये बदलणे
Budget ₹ मधून dollars मध्ये बदलणे

exp.en: A conversion is an action you define as valuable after an ad interaction: a sale, lead form, call, app install, etc. You must set up conversion tracking to count it.
exp.hi: Conversion woh action hai jo aap valuable define karte ho ad interaction ke baad: sale, lead form, call, app install. Isko count karne ke liye conversion tracking setup zaroori hai.
exp.mr: Conversion म्हणजे जाहिरातीशी interaction नंतर होणारी, तुम्ही मौल्यवान ठरवलेली कृती: sale, lead form, call, app install इ. ती मोजण्यासाठी conversion tracking लावावे लागते.

Relaunching a paused campaign with a new name
Showing ads to people who already visited your site or app
Re-uploading the same ad every week
hi: Ad account kisi aur agency ko bechna
Paused campaign ko naye naam se relaunch karna
Un logon ko ads dikhana jo pehle aapki site/app pe aa chuke hain
Har hafte same ad dobara upload karna
mr: Ad account दुसऱ्या agency ला विकणे

आधी तुमच्या site/app ला भेट दिलेल्या लोकांना जाहिराती दाखवणे
दर आठवड्याला तीच जाहिरात पुन्हा upload करणे

exp.en: Remarketing targets people who previously interacted with your website, app or videos, reminding warm users to come back and convert.
exp.hi: Remarketing un logon ko target karta hai jo pehle aapki website, app ya videos se interact kar chuke hain, taaki woh wapas aakar convert karein.
exp.mr: Remarketing आधी तुमच्या website, app किंवा videos शी interact केलेल्या लोकांना target करते, जेणेकरून ते परत येऊन convert होतील.

Budget khatam hone pe Google ka alert
mr: Phone call लावणारे button
'Free delivery' सारखा छोटा non-clickable text
Landing page वर येणारा pop-up
Budget संपल्यावर Google चा alert

exp.en: Callouts add short, non-clickable selling points (e.g. 'Free delivery', '24/7 support') to your ad. The call button is a separate call asset.
exp.hi: Callouts ad mein chhote non-clickable selling points add karte hain (jaise 'Free delivery', '24/7 support'). Call button alag call asset hai.
exp.mr: Callouts जाहिरातीत छोटे non-clickable selling points जोडतात (उदा. 'Free delivery', '24/7 support'). Call button हा वेगळा call asset आहे.

q.en: Your max CPC bid is ₹50. What do you usually pay per click in the Google Ads auction?
q.hi: Aapki max CPC bid ₹50 hai. Google Ads auction mein usually per click kitna pay karte ho?
q.mr: तुमची max CPC bid ₹50 आहे. Google Ads auction मध्ये सहसा प्रति क्लिक किती पैसे द्यावे लागतात?

en: Always exactly ₹50
Always double the max bid
Often less: just enough to beat the next Ad Rank
A fixed ₹10 set by Google
hi: Hamesha exactly ₹50
Hamesha max bid ka double
Aksar kam: bas agle Ad Rank ko beat karne jitna
Google ka fixed ₹10
mr: नेहमी बरोबर ₹50
नेहमी max bid च्या दुप्पट
बहुतेकदा कमी: पुढच्या Ad Rank ला मागे टाकण्याइतकेच
Google ने ठरवलेले fixed ₹10

exp.en: Actual CPC is often below your max CPC: you pay roughly what's needed to hold your position above the advertiser below you (and meet thresholds).
exp.hi: Actual CPC aksar max CPC se kam hota hai: aap lagbhag utna pay karte ho jitna neeche wale advertiser se upar rehne (aur thresholds meet karne) ke liye chahiye.
exp.mr: Actual CPC बहुतेकदा max CPC पेक्षा कमी असतो: खालच्या advertiser च्या वर राहण्यासाठी (आणि thresholds पूर्ण करण्यासाठी) लागणारी रक्कमच साधारण द्यावी लागते.

q.en: A Pune bakery's search ads get many clicks from people searching 'cake recipe' and 'how to bake cake at home', with zero orders. Best quick fix?
q.hi: Pune ki ek bakery ke search ads ko 'cake recipe' aur 'how to bake cake at home' search karne walon se bahut clicks milte hain, orders zero. Best quick fix?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका bakery च्या search ads ना 'cake recipe' आणि 'how to bake cake at home' शोधणाऱ्यांकडून खूप clicks मिळतात, पण order शून्य. सर्वोत्तम quick fix?

en: Increase the daily budget to get more clicks
Switch every keyword to broad match
Turn on the Display Network as well
Add 'recipe' and 'how to' as negative keywords
hi: Zyada clicks ke liye daily budget badhao
Saare keywords broad match pe kar do
Display Network bhi on kar do
'recipe' aur 'how to' ko negative keywords mein daalo
mr: जास्त clicks साठी daily budget वाढवा
सगळे keywords broad match करा
Display Network सुद्धा चालू करा
'recipe' आणि 'how to' negative keywords म्हणून टाका

exp.en: These searchers want to bake, not buy. Negatives like 'recipe' and 'how to' stop that waste. More budget or broader matching would only waste more money.
exp.hi: Yeh log khud bake karna chahte hain, khareedna nahi. 'recipe' aur 'how to' jaise negatives yeh waste rokte hain. Budget ya broad match badhane se aur paisa barbaad hoga.
exp.mr: हे लोक स्वतः bake करू इच्छितात, विकत घेऊ नाही. 'recipe' आणि 'how to' सारखे negatives हा खर्च थांबवतात. Budget वाढवणे किंवा broad match केल्याने आणखी पैसे वाया जातील.

q.en: What does the Search terms report in Google Ads show?
q.hi: Google Ads ki Search terms report kya dikhati hai?
q.mr: Google Ads चा Search terms report काय दाखवतो?

en: The actual searches that triggered your ads
Keywords your competitors are bidding on
Top trending searches across all of India
SEO rankings of your website pages
hi: Asli searches jinse aapke ads trigger hue
Keywords jin pe competitors bid kar rahe hain
Poore India ke top trending searches
Aapke website pages ki SEO rankings
mr: तुमच्या जाहिराती ज्या प्रत्यक्ष searches मुळे दिसल्या त्या
स्पर्धक bid करत असलेले keywords
संपूर्ण भारतातील top trending searches
तुमच्या website pages चे SEO rankings

exp.en: The Search terms report lists the real queries people typed that triggered your ads, which helps you find new keywords and negatives. It doesn't reveal competitor keywords.
exp.hi: Search terms report woh asli queries dikhati hai jo logon ne type ki aur jinse aapke ads aaye; isse naye keywords aur negatives milte hain. Competitors ke keywords nahi dikhte.
exp.mr: Search terms report लोकांनी type केलेल्या आणि तुमच्या जाहिराती दाखवणाऱ्या प्रत्यक्ष queries दाखवतो; त्यातून नवे keywords आणि negatives मिळतात. स्पर्धकांचे keywords यात दिसत नाहीत.

q.en: In Google Ads, what does Search impression share measure?
q.hi: Google Ads mein Search impression share kya measure karta hai?
q.mr: Google Ads मध्ये Search impression share काय मोजतो?

en: Your share of total clicks in your industry
Impressions received ÷ impressions you were eligible for
Your ad's position on the page, 1 to 10
Share of budget spent on search vs display
hi: Industry ke total clicks mein aapka share
Mile impressions ÷ jitne impressions ke eligible the
Page pe ad ki position, 1 se 10
Search vs display pe kharch hua budget share
mr: Industry मधील एकूण clicks मध्ये तुमचा वाटा
मिळालेले impressions ÷ ज्या impressions साठी पात्र होता ते
Page वर जाहिरातीचे स्थान, 1 ते 10
Search विरुद्ध display वर खर्च झालेल्या budget चा वाटा

exp.en: Impression share = impressions you got ÷ the estimated impressions you were eligible to get. It shows how much of the available demand you are capturing.
exp.hi: Impression share = mile impressions ÷ estimated eligible impressions. Isse pata chalta hai available demand ka kitna hissa aap capture kar rahe ho.
exp.mr: Impression share = मिळालेले impressions ÷ अंदाजे पात्र impressions. उपलब्ध demand पैकी किती भाग तुम्ही मिळवत आहात हे यातून कळते.

q.en: A campaign shows 'Search lost IS (budget)' of 45%. What does this mean?
q.hi: Ek campaign mein 'Search lost IS (budget)' 45% hai. Iska matlab kya hai?
q.mr: एका campaign मध्ये 'Search lost IS (budget)' 45% आहे. याचा अर्थ काय?

en: 45% of your clicks were invalid
Your Quality Score dropped by 45%
You missed ~45% of eligible impressions because budget ran short
45% of your budget was refunded
hi: Aapke 45% clicks invalid the
Quality Score 45% gir gaya
Budget kam padne se ~45% eligible impressions miss hue
Budget ka 45% refund hua
mr: तुमचे 45% clicks invalid होते
Quality Score 45% ने घसरला
Budget कमी पडल्याने ~45% पात्र impressions गमावले
Budget चा 45% परत मिळाला

exp.en: Lost IS (budget) is the share of eligible impressions you missed because your budget was too low. Missed impressions due to low Ad Rank show as Lost IS (rank).
exp.hi: Lost IS (budget) woh eligible impressions ka share hai jo budget kam hone se miss hue. Kam Ad Rank se miss hue impressions Lost IS (rank) mein dikhte hain.
exp.mr: Lost IS (budget) म्हणजे budget कमी पडल्यामुळे गमावलेल्या पात्र impressions चा वाटा. कमी Ad Rank मुळे गमावलेले impressions Lost IS (rank) मध्ये दिसतात.

q.en: What does the Maximize conversions bid strategy do?
q.hi: Maximize conversions bid strategy kya karti hai?
q.mr: Maximize conversions bid strategy काय करते?

en: Keeps every click at the lowest possible CPC
Shows your ad in the top position every time
Gets the most clicks regardless of conversions
Sets bids automatically to get the most conversions within budget
hi: Har click ko lowest possible CPC pe rakhti hai
Ad ko har baar top position pe dikhati hai
Conversions ki parwah kiye bina max clicks laati hai
Budget ke andar max conversions ke liye automatically bids set karti hai
mr: प्रत्येक click सर्वात कमी CPC वर ठेवते
जाहिरात नेहमी top position ला दाखवते
Conversions चा विचार न करता जास्तीत जास्त clicks आणते
Budget मध्ये जास्तीत जास्त conversions साठी आपोआप bids ठरवते

exp.en: Maximize conversions is a Smart Bidding strategy that sets bids in each auction to get as many conversions as possible while spending your budget. Maximize clicks is the one that chases clicks.
exp.hi: Maximize conversions Smart Bidding strategy hai jo har auction mein bids set karke budget ke andar max conversions laati hai. Clicks ke peeche Maximize clicks bhaagti hai.
exp.mr: Maximize conversions ही Smart Bidding strategy प्रत्येक auction मध्ये bids ठरवून budget मध्ये जास्तीत जास्त conversions आणते. Clicks मागे धावणारी strategy म्हणजे Maximize clicks.

q.en: What are enhanced conversions in Google Ads?
q.hi: Google Ads mein enhanced conversions kya hain?
q.mr: Google Ads मध्ये enhanced conversions म्हणजे काय?

en: Sending hashed first-party data (e.g. email) to improve conversion measurement
Paying extra so conversions are counted twice
A bid boost for users who converted before
Adding animations to ads to increase conversions
hi: Hashed first-party data (jaise email) bhejkar conversion measurement improve karna
Extra pay karke conversions do baar count karwana
Pehle convert hue users ke liye bid boost
Conversions badhane ke liye ads mein animations lagana
mr: Hashed first-party data (उदा. email) पाठवून conversion measurement सुधारणे
जास्त पैसे देऊन conversions दोनदा मोजणे
आधी convert झालेल्या users साठी bid boost
Conversions वाढवण्यासाठी जाहिरातीत animations टाकणे

exp.en: Enhanced conversions send hashed (SHA-256) customer data like email or phone from your conversion page, helping Google match conversions to ad clicks more accurately.
exp.hi: Enhanced conversions conversion page se email ya phone jaisa customer data hashed (SHA-256) form mein bhejte hain, taaki Google conversions ko ad clicks se zyada accurately match kare.
exp.mr: Enhanced conversions तुमच्या conversion page वरून email किंवा phone सारखा customer data hashed (SHA-256) स्वरूपात पाठवतात, त्यामुळे Google conversions आणि ad clicks अधिक अचूक जुळवते.

q.en: A Nagpur coaching institute targets 'Nagpur' in Google Ads but gets many leads from people living in other states who can't attend. Which setting should it fix first?
q.hi: Nagpur ka ek coaching institute Google Ads mein 'Nagpur' target karta hai, par dusre states mein rehne wale logon ki leads aati hain jo attend nahi kar sakte. Pehle kaunsi setting fix kare?
q.mr: नागपूरचे एक coaching institute Google Ads मध्ये 'Nagpur' target करते, पण इतर राज्यांत राहणाऱ्या, class ला येऊ न शकणाऱ्या लोकांचे leads येतात. आधी कोणती setting दुरुस्त करावी?

en: Change bidding to Maximize clicks
Set location option to 'Presence': people in or regularly in Nagpur
Add more headlines to the responsive search ad
Increase the daily budget for Nagpur
hi: Bidding ko Maximize clicks pe karo
Location option 'Presence' karo: jo log Nagpur mein hain ya regularly rehte hain
RSA mein aur headlines add karo
Nagpur ka daily budget badhao
mr: Bidding Maximize clicks वर करा
Location option 'Presence' करा: नागपुरात असलेले किंवा नियमित असणारे लोक
RSA मध्ये आणखी headlines टाका
नागपूरसाठी daily budget वाढवा

exp.en: The default 'Presence or interest' option also reaches people just searching about Nagpur. 'Presence' limits ads to people in, or regularly in, the target location.
exp.hi: Default 'Presence or interest' option un logon tak bhi pahunchta hai jo sirf Nagpur ke baare mein search karte hain. 'Presence' ads ko sirf location mein ya regularly wahan rehne walon tak rakhta hai.
exp.mr: Default 'Presence or interest' option फक्त नागपूरबद्दल शोधणाऱ्यांपर्यंतही पोहोचतो. 'Presence' जाहिराती फक्त त्या location मध्ये असलेल्या किंवा नियमित असणाऱ्या लोकांपुरत्या मर्यादित ठेवतो.

q.en: A D2C tea brand's RSA shows Ad strength 'Poor'. It has only 4 headlines, all saying 'Buy Assam Tea Online'. Best improvement?
q.hi: Ek D2C tea brand ke RSA ki Ad strength 'Poor' hai. Sirf 4 headlines hain, sab 'Buy Assam Tea Online' bol rahi hain. Best improvement?
q.mr: एका D2C tea brand च्या RSA ची Ad strength 'Poor' आहे. फक्त 4 headlines आहेत आणि सगळ्या 'Buy Assam Tea Online' म्हणतात. सर्वोत्तम सुधारणा?

en: Pin all four headlines to position 1
Delete the ad and use only sitelinks
Add more unique headlines: keywords, benefits, offers, CTAs
Raise the bid so Ad strength improves
hi: Chaaron headlines ko position 1 pe pin karo
Ad delete karke sirf sitelinks use karo
Aur unique headlines add karo: keywords, benefits, offers, CTAs
Bid badhao taaki Ad strength sudhre
mr: चारही headlines position 1 ला pin करा
जाहिरात delete करून फक्त sitelinks वापरा
आणखी वेगळ्या headlines टाका: keywords, benefits, offers, CTAs
Ad strength सुधारण्यासाठी bid वाढवा

exp.en: Ad strength rewards more, and more distinct, headlines and descriptions relevant to your keywords. Bids don't affect it, and heavy pinning reduces combinations.
exp.hi: Ad strength zyada aur alag-alag, keyword-relevant headlines/descriptions ko reward karti hai. Bid ka isse lena-dena nahi, aur zyada pinning combinations kam karti hai.
exp.mr: Ad strength जास्त संख्येच्या, वेगवेगळ्या आणि keywords शी relevant headlines/descriptions ना महत्त्व देते. Bid चा त्यावर परिणाम होत नाही, आणि जास्त pinning combinations कमी करते.

q.en: A Pune dental clinic gets most bookings by phone, and most searchers are on mobile. Which Google Ads addition helps most?
q.hi: Pune ke ek dental clinic ki zyada bookings phone se aati hain, aur zyada searchers mobile pe hain. Google Ads mein kya add karna sabse helpful hai?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका dental clinic च्या बहुतेक bookings phone वर येतात आणि बहुतेक searchers mobile वर असतात. Google Ads मध्ये काय जोडणे सर्वात उपयोगी?

en: A price asset listing every treatment
A YouTube bumper ad campaign
An App campaign for installs
A call asset, with calls tracked as conversions
hi: Har treatment ki list wala price asset
YouTube bumper ad campaign
Installs ke liye App campaign
Call asset, aur calls ko conversions ki tarah track karo
mr: प्रत्येक treatment ची यादी असलेला price asset
YouTube bumper ad campaign
Installs साठी App campaign
Call asset, आणि calls conversions म्हणून track करा

exp.en: A call asset adds a tap-to-call button on mobile ads, and tracking calls as conversions lets you see which keywords drive bookings.
exp.hi: Call asset mobile ads pe tap-to-call button laga deta hai, aur calls ko conversion track karne se pata chalta hai kaunse keywords bookings la rahe hain.
exp.mr: Call asset mobile ads वर tap-to-call button देतो, आणि calls conversions म्हणून track केल्याने कोणते keywords bookings आणतात ते कळते.

q.en: When auto-tagging is on in Google Ads, what gets added to your landing page URLs?
q.hi: Google Ads mein auto-tagging on ho to landing page URLs mein kya add hota hai?
q.mr: Google Ads मध्ये auto-tagging चालू असल्यास landing page URLs मध्ये काय जोडले जाते?

en: A GCLID (Google Click Identifier) parameter
The user's email address
Your Quality Score for that keyword
A discount coupon code
hi: GCLID (Google Click Identifier) parameter
User ka email address
Us keyword ka Quality Score
Discount coupon code
mr: GCLID (Google Click Identifier) parameter
User चा email address
त्या keyword चा Quality Score
Discount coupon code

exp.en: Auto-tagging appends a unique GCLID to each ad click URL. It links clicks to conversions and GA4 data, and is used for offline conversion imports.
exp.hi: Auto-tagging har ad click URL mein ek unique GCLID jodta hai. Isse clicks conversions aur GA4 data se link hote hain, aur offline conversion import mein kaam aata hai.
exp.mr: Auto-tagging प्रत्येक ad click URL ला एक unique GCLID जोडते. त्यामुळे clicks conversions व GA4 data शी जोडले जातात आणि offline conversion import साठीही ते वापरले जाते.

q.en: What does the Target CPA bid strategy aim to do?
q.hi: Target CPA bid strategy ka aim kya hai?
q.mr: Target CPA bid strategy चे उद्दिष्ट काय आहे?

en: Get the most clicks for a fixed cost per click
Get as many conversions as possible at your target average CPA
Guarantee every conversion costs less than the target
Show ads only when CPC is below the target
hi: Fixed CPC pe maximum clicks lana
Aapke target average CPA pe jitne ho sake utne conversions lana
Guarantee karna ki har conversion target se sasta ho
Ads tabhi dikhana jab CPC target se kam ho
mr: Fixed CPC वर जास्तीत जास्त clicks आणणे
तुमच्या target average CPA वर शक्य तितके conversions आणणे
प्रत्येक conversion target पेक्षा स्वस्त असेल याची खात्री
CPC target पेक्षा कमी असेल तेव्हाच जाहिराती दाखवणे

exp.en: Target CPA sets bids to get as many conversions as possible at the average cost per action you set. Some conversions will cost more and some less; it's an average, not a cap.
exp.hi: Target CPA bids aise set karta hai ki aapke diye average CPA pe max conversions milein. Kuch conversions mehenge, kuch saste honge; yeh average hai, cap nahi.
exp.mr: Target CPA तुम्ही दिलेल्या सरासरी CPA वर जास्तीत जास्त conversions मिळावेत अशा bids ठरवतो. काही conversions महाग, काही स्वस्त असतील; ही सरासरी आहे, मर्यादा नाही.

q.en: What best describes a Performance Max campaign?
q.hi: Performance Max campaign ko sabse sahi kaise describe karenge?
q.mr: Performance Max campaign चे सर्वात योग्य वर्णन कोणते?

en: A Search campaign that allows only exact match
A manual CPC campaign for Display banners only
One goal-based campaign across Google inventory like Search, YouTube, Display, Maps
A free campaign type for Google Business Profile
hi: Search campaign jismein sirf exact match allowed
Sirf Display banners ke liye manual CPC campaign
Ek goal-based campaign jo Search, YouTube, Display, Maps jaisi Google inventory pe chalta hai
Google Business Profile ka free campaign type
mr: फक्त exact match चालणारी Search campaign
फक्त Display banners साठी manual CPC campaign
Search, YouTube, Display, Maps सारख्या Google inventory वर चालणारी एकच goal-based campaign
Google Business Profile साठी free campaign type

exp.en: Performance Max uses one campaign, your assets and your conversion goals to serve across Google's channels (Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail, Maps) with automated bidding.
exp.hi: Performance Max ek hi campaign, aapke assets aur conversion goals use karke Google ke channels (Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail, Maps) pe automated bidding ke saath chalta hai.
exp.mr: Performance Max एकच campaign, तुमचे assets आणि conversion goals वापरून Google च्या channels वर (Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail, Maps) automated bidding सह चालते.

q.en: Google Ads Demand Gen campaigns (rolled out 2023-24) replaced which older campaign type?
q.hi: Google Ads ke Demand Gen campaigns (2023-24 mein aaye) ne kaunse purane campaign type ko replace kiya?
q.mr: Google Ads च्या Demand Gen campaigns (2023-24 मध्ये आलेल्या) ने कोणत्या जुन्या campaign type ची जागा घेतली?

en: Smart Shopping campaigns
Local campaigns
Expanded text ads
Discovery campaigns
hi: Smart Shopping campaigns
Local campaigns
Expanded text ads
Discovery campaigns
mr: Smart Shopping campaigns
Local campaigns
Expanded text ads
Discovery campaigns
