exp.hi: Demand Gen ne Discovery campaigns ko replace kiya, jo YouTube (Shorts bhi), Discover aur Gmail pe visual ads chalata hai. Smart Shopping aur Local campaigns Performance Max mein upgrade hue the.
exp.mr: Demand Gen ने Discovery campaigns ची जागा घेतली; ते YouTube (Shorts सह), Discover आणि Gmail वर visual ads चालवते. Smart Shopping आणि Local campaigns मात्र Performance Max मध्ये upgrade झाल्या.

q.en: In Google Ads, what is the difference between primary and secondary conversion actions?
q.hi: Google Ads mein primary aur secondary conversion actions mein kya farak hai?
q.mr: Google Ads मध्ये primary आणि secondary conversion actions मध्ये काय फरक आहे?

en: Primary actions are used for bidding; secondary are for observation only
Primary actions are paid; secondary actions are free
Secondary actions count double in the Conversions column
Primary is for mobile; secondary is for desktop
hi: Primary actions bidding ke liye use hote hain; secondary sirf observation ke liye
Primary paid hote hain; secondary free
Secondary actions Conversions column mein double count hote hain
Primary mobile ke liye; secondary desktop ke liye
mr: Primary actions bidding साठी वापरतात; secondary फक्त निरीक्षणासाठी
Primary पैसे देऊन; secondary मोफत
Secondary actions Conversions column मध्ये दुप्पट मोजले जातात
Primary mobile साठी; secondary desktop साठी

exp.en: Primary conversion actions appear in the 'Conversions' column and drive Smart Bidding. Secondary actions show in 'All conversions' for reporting but don't steer bids.
exp.hi: Primary conversion actions 'Conversions' column mein aate hain aur Smart Bidding ko chalate hain. Secondary 'All conversions' mein reporting ke liye dikhte hain, bids pe asar nahi.
exp.mr: Primary conversion actions 'Conversions' column मध्ये दिसतात आणि Smart Bidding चालवतात. Secondary actions 'All conversions' मध्ये reporting साठी दिसतात, bids वर परिणाम करत नाहीत.

q.en: A Surat saree D2C brand has a 25% profit margin on each order (after product and delivery costs). Roughly what ROAS does it need just to break even on ad spend?
q.hi: Surat ke ek saree D2C brand ka har order pe 25% profit margin hai (product aur delivery cost ke baad). Ad spend pe break even ke liye roughly kitna ROAS chahiye?
q.mr: सुरतच्या एका saree D2C brand चे प्रत्येक order वर 25% profit margin आहे (product आणि delivery खर्चानंतर). Ad spend वर break even साठी साधारण किती ROAS लागेल?

exp.en: Break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ margin = 1 ÷ 0.25 = 4x. Each ₹1 of ads must bring ₹4 of revenue, whose 25% margin (₹1) just covers the ad cost.
exp.hi: Break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ margin = 1 ÷ 0.25 = 4x. Har ₹1 ke ad pe ₹4 revenue chahiye, jiska 25% margin (₹1) ad cost cover karta hai.
exp.mr: Break-even ROAS = 1 ÷ margin = 1 ÷ 0.25 = 4x. प्रत्येक ₹1 जाहिरातीवर ₹4 revenue हवा, ज्याचा 25% margin (₹1) जाहिरातीचा खर्च भरून काढतो.

q.en: A new Google Ads account for a Mumbai interior designer has no conversion tracking yet. The owner wants to use Target CPA right away. What should you do first?
q.hi: Mumbai ke ek interior designer ka naya Google Ads account hai, conversion tracking abhi nahi hai. Owner turant Target CPA use karna chahta hai. Pehle kya karoge?
q.mr: मुंबईच्या एका interior designer चे नवे Google Ads account आहे, conversion tracking अजून नाही. Owner ला लगेच Target CPA वापरायचा आहे. आधी काय कराल?

en: Set Target CPA very low to save money
Switch to Display Network for cheaper clicks
Set up conversion tracking for leads and calls
Increase the budget so Google learns faster
hi: Paisa bachane ke liye Target CPA bahut kam rakho
Saste clicks ke liye Display Network pe jao
Leads aur calls ke liye conversion tracking setup karo
Budget badhao taaki Google jaldi seekhe
mr: पैसे वाचवण्यासाठी Target CPA खूप कमी ठेवा
स्वस्त clicks साठी Display Network वर जा
Leads आणि calls साठी conversion tracking सेट करा
Google लवकर शिकावे म्हणून budget वाढवा

exp.en: Conversion-based Smart Bidding needs conversion data to optimize. Without tracking, Target CPA has nothing to learn from, so tracking comes first.
exp.hi: Conversion-based Smart Bidding ko optimize karne ke liye conversion data chahiye. Tracking ke bina Target CPA ke paas seekhne ko kuch nahi, isliye pehle tracking.
exp.mr: Conversion-based Smart Bidding ला optimize करण्यासाठी conversion data लागतो. Tracking शिवाय Target CPA ला शिकण्यासाठी काहीच नसते, म्हणून आधी tracking.

q.en: A Jaipur jewellery store's Shopping products are disapproved in Merchant Center for 'price mismatch'. What's the right fix?
q.hi: Jaipur ke ek jewellery store ke Shopping products Merchant Center mein 'price mismatch' ki wajah se disapproved hain. Sahi fix kya hai?
q.mr: जयपूरच्या एका jewellery store चे Shopping products Merchant Center मध्ये 'price mismatch' मुळे disapproved आहेत. योग्य उपाय कोणता?

en: Raise the Shopping campaign's bids
Remove prices from the landing pages
Create a new Merchant Center account
Make feed prices match the landing page prices
hi: Shopping campaign ki bids badhao
Landing pages se prices hata do
Naya Merchant Center account banao
Feed ki prices ko landing page ki prices se match karo
mr: Shopping campaign च्या bids वाढवा
Landing pages वरून किंमती काढून टाका
नवे Merchant Center account बनवा
Feed मधील किंमती landing page वरील किंमतींशी जुळवा

exp.en: Merchant Center requires the feed price to match the price shown on the landing page. Update the feed (or its sync) so they match; bids or new accounts won't fix it.
exp.hi: Merchant Center chahta hai ki feed price landing page ki price se match kare. Feed (ya uska sync) update karo; bids ya naya account se yeh fix nahi hoga.
exp.mr: Merchant Center नुसार feed मधील किंमत landing page वरील किंमतीशी जुळली पाहिजे. Feed (किंवा त्याचे sync) update करा; bids किंवा नव्या account ने हे सुटणार नाही.

q.en: What are RLSA (Remarketing Lists for Search Ads) used for?
q.hi: RLSA (Remarketing Lists for Search Ads) kis kaam aate hain?
q.mr: RLSA (Remarketing Lists for Search Ads) कशासाठी वापरतात?

en: Tailoring search bids and ads for people who visited your site before
Showing banner ads on news websites
Finding new keywords from competitor sites
Sending SMS to people who searched your brand
hi: Pehle site visit kar chuke logon ke liye search bids aur ads customize karna
News websites pe banner ads dikhana
Competitor sites se naye keywords dhoondhna
Brand search karne walon ko SMS bhejna
mr: आधी site ला भेट दिलेल्या लोकांसाठी search bids आणि ads बदलणे
News websites वर banner ads दाखवणे
स्पर्धकांच्या sites मधून नवे keywords शोधणे
Brand शोधणाऱ्यांना SMS पाठवणे

exp.en: RLSA lets you adjust bids, keywords or ads in Search campaigns when past visitors search again, since they are usually more likely to convert.
exp.hi: RLSA se aap Search campaigns mein bids, keywords ya ads adjust kar sakte ho jab purane visitors dobara search karein, kyunki woh zyada convert karte hain.
exp.mr: RLSA मुळे जुने visitors पुन्हा search करतात तेव्हा Search campaigns मध्ये bids, keywords किंवा ads बदलता येतात, कारण ते convert होण्याची शक्यता जास्त असते.

q.en: Which of these is NOT a factor Google uses to calculate Ad Rank?
q.hi: Inmein se kaunsa factor Google Ad Rank calculate karne mein use NAHI karta?
q.mr: यापैकी कोणता घटक Google Ad Rank काढण्यासाठी वापरत नाही?

en: Your bid
Your total monthly account spend
Quality of your ads and landing page
The context of the search (device, location, time)
hi: Aapki bid
Aapka total monthly account spend
Ads aur landing page ki quality
Search ka context (device, location, time)
mr: तुमची bid
तुमचा एकूण monthly account spend
जाहिराती आणि landing page ची quality
Search चा context (device, location, वेळ)

exp.en: Ad Rank uses your bid, ad and landing page quality, Ad Rank thresholds, search context and expected impact of assets. How much you spend overall doesn't buy a better rank.
exp.hi: Ad Rank bid, ad aur landing page quality, Ad Rank thresholds, search context aur assets ke expected impact pe based hai. Total kitna kharch karte ho, usse rank nahi milti.
exp.mr: Ad Rank तुमची bid, जाहिरात व landing page quality, Ad Rank thresholds, search context आणि assets चा अपेक्षित परिणाम यावर ठरतो. एकूण किती खर्च करता त्याने rank मिळत नाही.

q.en: You add 'job' as a negative keyword. Why might ads still show for 'jobs' searches?
q.hi: Aapne 'job' negative keyword add kiya. Phir bhi 'jobs' searches pe ads kyun aa sakte hain?
q.mr: तुम्ही 'job' negative keyword म्हणून टाकला. तरीही 'jobs' searches वर जाहिराती का येऊ शकतात?

en: Negative keywords only work on Display
Negatives take 30 days to activate
Negative keywords don't match close variants like plurals
Google ignores negatives when budget is high
hi: Negative keywords sirf Display pe chalte hain
Negatives activate hone mein 30 din lagte hain
Negative keywords plurals jaise close variants match nahi karte
Budget zyada ho to Google negatives ignore karta hai
mr: Negative keywords फक्त Display वर चालतात
Negatives चालू व्हायला 30 दिवस लागतात
Negative keywords plurals सारखे close variants match करत नाहीत
Budget जास्त असल्यास Google negatives दुर्लक्षित करते

exp.en: Unlike normal keywords, negatives don't expand to close variants such as plurals or misspellings, so you must add 'jobs' separately.
exp.hi: Normal keywords ke ulat, negatives plurals ya misspellings jaise close variants tak expand nahi hote, isliye 'jobs' alag se add karna padega.
exp.mr: सामान्य keywords प्रमाणे negatives plurals किंवा misspellings सारख्या close variants पर्यंत पसरत नाहीत, म्हणून 'jobs' वेगळा टाकावा लागतो.

q.en: What is a portfolio bid strategy in Google Ads?
q.hi: Google Ads mein portfolio bid strategy kya hai?
q.mr: Google Ads मध्ये portfolio bid strategy म्हणजे काय?

en: A report comparing bids against competitors
A list of keywords saved for future use
A strategy that bids only on brand keywords
One automated bid strategy shared across multiple campaigns
hi: Competitors ke saath bids compare karne wali report
Future ke liye save kiye keywords ki list
Sirf brand keywords pe bid karne wali strategy
Ek automated bid strategy jo kai campaigns mein share hoti hai
mr: स्पर्धकांशी bids ची तुलना करणारा report
भविष्यासाठी save केलेली keywords ची यादी
फक्त brand keywords वर bid करणारी strategy
अनेक campaigns मध्ये share होणारी एक automated bid strategy

exp.en: A portfolio bid strategy groups several campaigns under one automated strategy (e.g. a shared Target CPA), letting Google balance bids across them to hit the overall goal.
exp.hi: Portfolio bid strategy kai campaigns ko ek automated strategy (jaise shared Target CPA) mein group karti hai, taaki Google overall goal ke liye unke beech bids balance kare.
exp.mr: Portfolio bid strategy अनेक campaigns एका automated strategy (उदा. shared Target CPA) खाली आणते, जेणेकरून Google एकूण goal साठी त्यांच्यात bids balance करते.

q.en: A Pune real-estate developer gets cheap form leads on Maximize conversions, but the sales team says most are junk. Best next step?
q.hi: Pune ke ek real-estate developer ko Maximize conversions pe saste form leads milte hain, par sales team kehti hai zyada junk hain. Best next step?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका real-estate developer ला Maximize conversions वर स्वस्त form leads मिळतात, पण sales team म्हणते बहुतेक junk आहेत. पुढची सर्वोत्तम पायरी?

en: Import qualified leads/site visits from the CRM (via GCLID) and optimize to them
Switch to Maximize clicks to get more traffic
Remove the form and ask users to email instead
Cut the budget by half and wait
hi: CRM se qualified leads/site visits (GCLID ke through) import karke unpe optimize karo
Zyada traffic ke liye Maximize clicks pe switch karo
Form hata ke users ko email karne bolo
Budget aadha karke wait karo
mr: CRM मधून qualified leads/site visits (GCLID द्वारे) import करून त्यावर optimize करा
जास्त traffic साठी Maximize clicks वर जा
Form काढून users ना email करायला सांगा
Budget अर्धे करून वाट पाहा

exp.en: Bidding optimizes for whatever you call a conversion. Importing offline, qualified outcomes teaches Smart Bidding to find buyers, not just form-fillers.
exp.hi: Bidding usi cheez pe optimize karti hai jise aap conversion bolte ho. Offline qualified outcomes import karne se Smart Bidding buyers dhoondhna seekhti hai, sirf form bharne wale nahi.
exp.mr: तुम्ही ज्याला conversion म्हणता त्यावरच bidding optimize होते. Offline qualified outcomes import केल्याने Smart Bidding फक्त form भरणारे नव्हे तर खरे buyers शोधायला शिकते.

q.en: An online gift store set Target ROAS to 800% while it usually achieves around 350%. Now the campaign barely spends. Most likely reason and fix?
q.hi: Ek online gift store ne Target ROAS 800% set kiya jabki usually 350% ke aas-paas aata hai. Ab campaign mushkil se spend karta hai. Sabse likely reason aur fix?
q.mr: एका online gift store ने Target ROAS 800% ठेवला, पण सहसा तो सुमारे 350% मिळवतो. आता campaign जवळजवळ खर्चच करत नाही. संभाव्य कारण आणि उपाय?

en: Budget too high; reduce the budget
Target is unrealistic and limits bids; lower it closer to actual
Ads are disapproved; rewrite all ads
Quality Score is 10; add worse keywords
hi: Budget zyada hai; budget kam karo
Target unrealistic hai aur bids limit kar raha hai; actual ke paas laao
Ads disapproved hain; saare ads dobara likho
Quality Score 10 hai; kharab keywords add karo
mr: Budget जास्त आहे; budget कमी करा
Target अवास्तव असून bids मर्यादित करतो; तो प्रत्यक्ष ROAS जवळ आणा
Ads disapproved आहेत; सगळ्या ads पुन्हा लिहा
Quality Score 10 आहे; वाईट keywords टाका

exp.en: A Target ROAS far above what you achieve makes Smart Bidding bid very conservatively, so volume collapses. Set it near historical ROAS and adjust gradually.
exp.hi: Actual se bahut upar Target ROAS rakhne se Smart Bidding bahut kam bid karti hai, isliye volume gir jaata hai. Historical ROAS ke paas rakho aur dheere-dheere adjust karo.
exp.mr: प्रत्यक्षापेक्षा खूप जास्त Target ROAS ठेवल्यास Smart Bidding खूप कमी bids लावते, त्यामुळे volume कोसळतो. तो historical ROAS जवळ ठेवा आणि हळूहळू बदला.

q.en: An electronics store runs a 3-day Diwali flash sale and expects conversion rates to jump sharply. It uses Smart Bidding. What should it set up?
q.hi: Ek electronics store 3-din ki Diwali flash sale chala raha hai aur conversion rate mein bada jump expect karta hai. Smart Bidding use hoti hai. Kya setup kare?
q.mr: एक electronics store 3 दिवसांचा Diwali flash sale चालवत आहे आणि conversion rate मध्ये मोठी वाढ अपेक्षित आहे. Smart Bidding वापरात आहे. काय सेट करावे?

en: A data exclusion for the sale days
A new account just for the sale
A seasonality adjustment for the sale dates
A switch to Manual CPC for one month
hi: Sale ke dinon ke liye data exclusion
Sirf sale ke liye naya account
Sale ki dates ke liye seasonality adjustment
Ek mahine ke liye Manual CPC pe switch
mr: Sale च्या दिवसांसाठी data exclusion
फक्त sale साठी नवे account
Sale च्या तारखांसाठी seasonality adjustment
एक महिन्यासाठी Manual CPC वर switch

exp.en: Seasonality adjustments tell Smart Bidding to expect a short-term conversion-rate change (best for a few days). Data exclusions are for broken tracking, not sales.
exp.hi: Seasonality adjustments Smart Bidding ko batate hain ki thode din conversion rate badlega (short events ke liye best). Data exclusions tracking kharab hone ke liye hain, sale ke liye nahi.
exp.mr: Seasonality adjustments Smart Bidding ला अल्पकाळ conversion rate बदलणार आहे हे सांगतात (काही दिवसांच्या events साठी उत्तम). Data exclusions हे tracking बिघडल्यावर वापरतात, sale साठी नाही.

q.en: A Bengaluru shoe brand finds a competitor's ads appearing when people search its brand name. What's the most practical response?
q.hi: Bengaluru ke ek shoe brand ne dekha ki uske brand name search karne pe competitor ke ads aate hain. Sabse practical response kya hai?
q.mr: बेंगळुरूच्या एका shoe brand ला दिसले की त्याचे brand name शोधल्यावर स्पर्धकाच्या जाहिराती येतात. सर्वात व्यावहारिक प्रतिसाद कोणता?

en: Ask Google to ban the competitor's account
Stop all ads until the competitor stops
Bid on the competitor's brand in your ad text
Run your own brand campaign; report only trademark misuse in ad text
hi: Google se competitor ka account ban karwao
Competitor ruke tab tak saare ads band karo
Apne ad text mein competitor ka brand use karo
Apna brand campaign chalao; ad text mein trademark misuse ho to hi report karo
mr: Google कडून स्पर्धकाचे account ban करून घ्या
स्पर्धक थांबेपर्यंत सगळ्या जाहिराती बंद करा
तुमच्या ad text मध्ये स्पर्धकाचा brand वापरा
स्वतःची brand campaign चालवा; ad text मध्ये trademark misuse असल्यासच report करा

exp.en: In most regions Google allows bidding on others' brand terms as keywords; its trademark policy mainly covers use in ad text. Your own brand ads are usually cheap and highly relevant.
exp.hi: Zyadatar regions mein Google dusre ke brand terms pe keyword bidding allow karta hai; trademark policy mainly ad text ke use ko cover karti hai. Apne brand ads usually saste aur bahut relevant hote hain.
exp.mr: बहुतेक regions मध्ये Google दुसऱ्याच्या brand terms वर keyword bidding करू देते; trademark policy मुख्यतः ad text मधील वापराला लागू होते. स्वतःच्या brand ads सहसा स्वस्त व अत्यंत relevant असतात.

q.en: A Search campaign and a Performance Max campaign in the same account could both serve for a query. When does the Search campaign get priority?
q.hi: Same account mein Search aur Performance Max dono campaign ek query pe serve ho sakte hain. Search campaign ko priority kab milti hai?
q.mr: एकाच account मधील Search आणि Performance Max दोन्ही campaigns एका query वर serve होऊ शकतात. Search campaign ला priority कधी मिळते?

en: When a Search keyword is identical to the user's query
Always, because Search is older
Only when the Search budget is higher
Never; Performance Max always wins
hi: Jab Search ka koi keyword user ki query se bilkul identical ho
Hamesha, kyunki Search purana hai
Sirf jab Search ka budget zyada ho
Kabhi nahi; Performance Max hamesha jeet-ta hai
mr: Search मधील keyword user च्या query शी अगदी identical असेल तेव्हा
नेहमी, कारण Search जुने आहे
फक्त Search चे budget जास्त असेल तेव्हा
कधीच नाही; Performance Max नेहमी जिंकते

exp.en: Google prioritizes a Search campaign when the user's query is identical to one of its keywords. Otherwise the campaign with the higher Ad Rank serves, which may be Performance Max.
exp.hi: Jab user ki query Search campaign ke kisi keyword se identical ho, Google Search ko priority deta hai. Warna jiska Ad Rank zyada, woh serve hota hai, jo PMax bhi ho sakta hai.
exp.mr: User ची query Search campaign मधील keyword शी identical असल्यास Google Search ला priority देते. अन्यथा ज्याचा Ad Rank जास्त ती campaign serve होते, ती Performance Max असू शकते.

q.en: Your website's conversion tag broke for 4 days, so Google Ads recorded almost no conversions. Which tool stops Smart Bidding learning from that bad data?
q.hi: Website ka conversion tag 4 din tak toota raha, isliye Google Ads ne almost zero conversions record kiye. Kaunsa tool Smart Bidding ko us kharab data se seekhne se rokta hai?
q.mr: Website चा conversion tag 4 दिवस बिघडला होता, त्यामुळे Google Ads ने जवळपास शून्य conversions नोंदवले. कोणते tool Smart Bidding ला त्या चुकीच्या data वरून शिकण्यापासून थांबवते?

en: Seasonality adjustment
Data exclusion
Ad schedule
Negative keyword list
hi: Seasonality adjustment
Data exclusion
Ad schedule
Negative keyword list
mr: Seasonality adjustment
Data exclusion
Ad schedule
Negative keyword list

exp.en: A data exclusion tells Smart Bidding to ignore conversion data from dates with tracking problems. Seasonality adjustments are for expected real changes like sales.
exp.hi: Data exclusion Smart Bidding ko tracking problem wali dates ka conversion data ignore karne ko bolta hai. Seasonality adjustments sale jaise asli expected changes ke liye hain.
exp.mr: Data exclusion Smart Bidding ला tracking अडचणी असलेल्या तारखांचा conversion data दुर्लक्षित करायला सांगते. Seasonality adjustments हे sale सारख्या खऱ्या अपेक्षित बदलांसाठी असतात.

q.en: In Google Ads Auction insights, what does 'Overlap rate' show?
q.hi: Google Ads Auction insights mein 'Overlap rate' kya dikhata hai?
q.mr: Google Ads Auction insights मध्ये 'Overlap rate' काय दाखवतो?

en: How often your ads overlap on the same web page
How many keywords you share with a competitor
How often a competitor's ad showed when yours also showed
How much of your budget a competitor used
hi: Kitni baar aapke ads ek hi web page pe overlap hue
Competitor ke saath kitne keywords share hain
Kitni baar competitor ka ad bhi dikha jab aapka dikha
Competitor ne aapka kitna budget use kiya
mr: तुमच्या जाहिराती एकाच web page वर किती वेळा overlap झाल्या
स्पर्धकाशी किती keywords share आहेत
तुमची जाहिरात दिसली तेव्हा स्पर्धकाची जाहिरातही किती वेळा दिसली
स्पर्धकाने तुमचे किती budget वापरले

exp.en: Overlap rate is how often another advertiser's ad got an impression in the same auctions where yours did. It shows who you compete with most, not their keyword list.
exp.hi: Overlap rate batata hai kitni baar dusre advertiser ka ad usi auction mein dikha jismein aapka dikha. Isse pata chalta hai sabse zyada competition kisse hai, unki keyword list nahi.
exp.mr: Overlap rate म्हणजे तुमची जाहिरात दिसलेल्या auctions मध्ये दुसऱ्या advertiser ची जाहिरातही किती वेळा दिसली. सर्वाधिक स्पर्धा कोणाशी आहे हे कळते, त्यांची keyword list नाही.

q.en: A Pune coaching institute's CPC rose 40% in a month. CTR, Quality Score and ads are unchanged, and Auction insights show a new competitor with rising overlap and outranking share. Best interpretation?
q.hi: Pune ke ek coaching institute ka CPC ek mahine mein 40% badh gaya. CTR, Quality Score aur ads same hain, aur Auction insights mein ek naya competitor rising overlap aur outranking share ke saath dikh raha hai. Best interpretation?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका coaching institute चा CPC एका महिन्यात 40% वाढला. CTR, Quality Score आणि ads तसेच आहेत, आणि Auction insights मध्ये वाढता overlap व outranking share असलेला नवा स्पर्धक दिसतो. सर्वोत्तम अर्थ?

en: Google is penalizing the account; open a new one
The landing page broke; rebuild the whole website
Clicks are fake; pause the campaign
Auction competition rose; review bids vs CPA and sharpen relevance
hi: Google account ko penalize kar raha hai; naya account kholo
Landing page toot gaya; poori website dobara banao
Clicks fake hain; campaign pause karo
Auction competition badha; CPA ke hisaab se bids review karo aur relevance sudharo
mr: Google account ला दंड करत आहे; नवे account उघडा
Landing page बिघडले; संपूर्ण website पुन्हा बनवा
Clicks बनावट आहेत; campaign pause करा
Auction मधील स्पर्धा वाढली; CPA नुसार bids तपासा आणि relevance सुधारा

exp.en: With your own quality metrics stable, a new aggressive bidder in Auction insights explains higher CPCs. Decide bids based on your CPA target and improve ad relevance rather than panic.
exp.hi: Aapke quality metrics stable hain, to Auction insights mein naya aggressive bidder hi CPC badhne ki wajah hai. Apne CPA target ke hisaab se bids decide karo aur relevance sudharo, panic mat karo.
exp.mr: तुमचे quality metrics स्थिर असताना Auction insights मधील नवा आक्रमक bidder हेच CPC वाढीचे कारण आहे. CPA target नुसार bids ठरवा आणि relevance सुधारा, घाबरू नका.

q.en: After a website redesign, a Kolkata furniture store's Google Ads conversions dropped to almost zero overnight, while clicks and GA4 sessions look normal. What should you check first?
q.hi: Website redesign ke baad Kolkata ke ek furniture store ke Google Ads conversions raaton-raat almost zero ho gaye, jabki clicks aur GA4 sessions normal hain. Pehle kya check karoge?
q.mr: Website redesign नंतर कोलकात्याच्या एका furniture store चे Google Ads conversions रातोरात जवळपास शून्य झाले, पण clicks आणि GA4 sessions सामान्य आहेत. आधी काय तपासाल?

en: Whether the conversion tag still fires on the new site
Whether competitors have raised their bids
Whether the ad copy needs new headlines
Whether the daily budget should be doubled
hi: Kya conversion tag nayi site pe abhi bhi fire ho raha hai
Kya competitors ne bids badha di
Kya ad copy ko nayi headlines chahiye
Kya daily budget double karna chahiye
mr: Conversion tag नव्या site वर अजूनही fire होतो का
स्पर्धकांनी bids वाढवल्या का
Ad copy ला नव्या headlines हव्यात का
Daily budget दुप्पट करावे का

exp.en: Normal traffic but vanished conversions right after a site change almost always means the tag was removed or broken. Check tag diagnostics or Tag Assistant first.
exp.hi: Traffic normal par site change ke turant baad conversions gaayab, yeh almost hamesha tag hatne ya tootne ka sign hai. Pehle tag diagnostics ya Tag Assistant check karo.
exp.mr: Traffic सामान्य पण site बदलानंतर लगेच conversions गायब, याचा अर्थ जवळपास नेहमीच tag काढला गेला किंवा बिघडला. आधी tag diagnostics किंवा Tag Assistant तपासा.

q.en: A Pune bakery's Display campaign gets lots of cheap clicks but zero orders. The placements report shows most clicks come from mobile game apps. Best action?
q.hi: Pune ki ek bakery ke Display campaign ko bahut saste clicks milte hain par orders zero. Placements report dikhati hai zyada clicks mobile game apps se aa rahe hain. Best action?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका bakery च्या Display campaign ला खूप स्वस्त clicks मिळतात पण orders शून्य. Placements report दाखवतो की बहुतेक clicks mobile game apps मधून येतात. सर्वोत्तम कृती?

en: Raise bids to win better placements automatically
Exclude the low-quality app placements
Switch the campaign to Maximize clicks
Add more images so game users convert
hi: Bids badhao taaki automatically better placements milein
Low-quality app placements ko exclude karo
Campaign ko Maximize clicks pe switch karo
Aur images add karo taaki game users convert hon
mr: आपोआप चांगले placements मिळावेत म्हणून bids वाढवा
कमी quality चे app placements exclude करा
Campaign Maximize clicks वर switch करा
Game users convert व्हावेत म्हणून आणखी images टाका

exp.en: Clicks inside games are often accidental taps. Excluding those placements stops the waste; chasing clicks would make it worse.
exp.hi: Games ke andar clicks aksar galti se hue taps hote hain. Un placements ko exclude karne se waste rukta hai; clicks ke peeche bhaagne se aur bura hoga.
exp.mr: Games मधील clicks बहुतेकदा चुकून झालेले taps असतात. ते placements exclude केल्याने खर्च वाचतो; clicks मागे धावल्यास स्थिती आणखी बिघडेल.

q.en: An insurance agent runs broad match keywords with Manual CPC and no conversion tracking. Spend is high on irrelevant searches. What's the best fix?
q.hi: Ek insurance agent broad match keywords Manual CPC pe chala raha hai, conversion tracking nahi hai. Irrelevant searches pe kharcha zyada ho raha hai. Best fix kya hai?
q.mr: एक insurance agent Manual CPC वर broad match keywords चालवतो, conversion tracking नाही. Irrelevant searches वर खर्च जास्त होत आहे. सर्वोत्तम उपाय कोणता?

en: Add more broad match keywords to find new buyers
Turn on search partners for cheaper clicks
Add tracking; until Smart Bidding has data, use phrase/exact plus negatives
Raise max CPC so better users see the ads
hi: Naye buyers ke liye aur broad match keywords daalo
Saste clicks ke liye search partners on karo
Tracking lagao; jab tak Smart Bidding ke paas data na ho, phrase/exact aur negatives use karo
Max CPC badhao taaki better users ads dekhein
mr: नवे buyers शोधण्यासाठी आणखी broad match keywords टाका
स्वस्त clicks साठी search partners चालू करा
Tracking लावा; Smart Bidding कडे data येईपर्यंत phrase/exact आणि negatives वापरा
चांगल्या users ना ads दिसाव्यात म्हणून max CPC वाढवा

exp.en: Google recommends pairing broad match with Smart Bidding, which uses conversion signals to filter queries. Without tracking, tighter match types plus negatives control waste.
exp.hi: Google broad match ko Smart Bidding ke saath use karne ki salah deta hai, jo conversion signals se queries filter karti hai. Tracking ke bina tight match types aur negatives se waste control hota hai.
exp.mr: Google broad match हे Smart Bidding सोबत वापरायला सांगते, जी conversion signals वापरून queries गाळते. Tracking शिवाय tight match types आणि negatives नेच खर्च नियंत्रणात राहतो.

q.en: An e-commerce site sends the same fixed value for every purchase, though orders range from ₹300 to ₹30,000. Why is passing the actual order value better?
q.hi: Ek e-commerce site har purchase ke liye same fixed value bhejti hai, jabki orders ₹300 se ₹30,000 tak hote hain. Actual order value bhejna kyun better hai?
q.mr: एक e-commerce site प्रत्येक purchase साठी एकच fixed value पाठवते, पण orders ₹300 ते ₹30,000 पर्यंत असतात. प्रत्यक्ष order value पाठवणे का चांगले?

en: It lowers the CPC on every keyword
It is required to run Search ads at all
It stops Google from counting duplicate orders
It lets value-based bidding (e.g. Target ROAS) favour high-value orders
hi: Har keyword ka CPC kam karta hai
Search ads chalane ke liye zaroori hai
Google ko duplicate orders count karne se rokta hai
Value-based bidding (jaise Target ROAS) ko high-value orders prefer karne deta hai
mr: प्रत्येक keyword चा CPC कमी करते
Search ads चालवण्यासाठी आवश्यकच आहे
Google ला duplicate orders मोजण्यापासून थांबवते
Value-based bidding (उदा. Target ROAS) ला जास्त value च्या orders ना प्राधान्य देऊ देते

exp.en: Dynamic values let Target ROAS or Maximize conversion value bid more for searches likely to bring big orders. Duplicates are handled with transaction IDs, not values.
exp.hi: Dynamic values se Target ROAS ya Maximize conversion value un searches pe zyada bid karte hain jahan bade orders ki sambhavna ho. Duplicates transaction IDs se handle hote hain, values se nahi.
exp.mr: Dynamic values मुळे Target ROAS किंवा Maximize conversion value मोठे orders येण्याची शक्यता असलेल्या searches वर जास्त bid करतात. Duplicates transaction IDs ने हाताळले जातात, values ने नाही.

q.en: What does the 'click-through conversion window' setting control in Google Ads?
q.hi: Google Ads mein 'click-through conversion window' setting kya control karti hai?
q.mr: Google Ads मध्ये 'click-through conversion window' setting काय नियंत्रित करते?

en: How many days after an ad click a conversion is still counted
How long an ad stays live before it expires
How many clicks a single user can make per day
The hours of the day when ads can show
hi: Ad click ke kitne din baad tak conversion count hoga
Ad expire hone se pehle kitne din live rahega
Ek user roz kitne clicks kar sakta hai
Din ke kaunse ghante ads dikh sakte hain
mr: Ad click नंतर किती दिवसांपर्यंत conversion मोजला जाईल
जाहिरात expire होण्यापूर्वी किती काळ live राहील
एक user दररोज किती clicks करू शकतो
दिवसातील कोणत्या तासांत जाहिराती दिसू शकतात

exp.en: The conversion window (30 days by default for click-through) sets how long after a click a conversion is credited. Long sales cycles may need a longer window; ad hours are set by ad schedule.
exp.hi: Conversion window (click-through ke liye default 30 din) batata hai click ke kitne din baad tak conversion credit hoga. Lambi sales cycle ho to lamba window; ad ke ghante ad schedule se set hote hain.
exp.mr: Conversion window (click-through साठी default 30 दिवस) click नंतर किती काळ conversion चे श्रेय दिले जाईल हे ठरवते. दीर्घ sales cycle असल्यास मोठा window लागू शकतो; जाहिरातीचे तास ad schedule ने ठरतात.

q.en: How does Google Ads treat clicks it identifies as invalid (e.g. bots or accidental repeat clicks)?
q.hi: Google Ads un clicks ke saath kya karta hai jinhe woh invalid identify karta hai (jaise bots ya galti se repeat clicks)?
q.mr: Google Ads ज्या clicks ना invalid ओळखते (उदा. bots किंवा चुकून झालेले repeat clicks) त्यांचे काय करते?

en: Charges double to discourage them
Filters them so you aren't charged, or credits them later
Blocks your account until you verify each click
Counts them as conversions automatically
hi: Rokne ke liye double charge karta hai
Unhe filter karta hai taaki charge na ho, ya baad mein credit deta hai
Har click verify hone tak account block karta hai
Unhe automatically conversions gin leta hai
mr: त्यांना आळा घालण्यासाठी दुप्पट charge करते
ते filter करते म्हणजे charge लागत नाही, किंवा नंतर credit देते
प्रत्येक click verify होईपर्यंत account block करते
त्यांना आपोआप conversions म्हणून मोजते

exp.en: Google automatically filters invalid clicks so you aren't charged; if some are caught later, it issues credits. You can see them in the Invalid clicks column.
exp.hi: Google invalid clicks ko automatically filter karta hai taaki aapko charge na ho; baad mein pakde gaye to credit deta hai. Invalid clicks column mein dekh sakte ho.
exp.mr: Google invalid clicks आपोआप filter करते म्हणजे तुम्हाला charge लागत नाही; नंतर सापडल्यास credit देते. हे Invalid clicks column मध्ये दिसतात.

q.en: A coaching institute's Google Ads show a great cost per lead, but the CRM shows far fewer unique leads. Students often submit the enquiry form 2-3 times. What's the likely setting fix?
q.hi: Ek coaching institute ke Google Ads mein cost per lead bahut accha dikhta hai, par CRM mein unique leads kaafi kam hain. Students aksar enquiry form 2-3 baar bharte hain. Likely setting fix kya hai?
q.mr: एका coaching institute च्या Google Ads मध्ये cost per lead छान दिसतो, पण CRM मध्ये unique leads खूप कमी आहेत. Students अनेकदा enquiry form 2-3 वेळा भरतात. संभाव्य setting fix कोणता?

en: Shorten the conversion window to 1 day
Switch attribution to last click
Set the lead conversion's counting to 'One' per click
Mark the lead conversion as secondary
hi: Conversion window 1 din kar do
Attribution last click pe kar do
Lead conversion ki counting 'One' per click set karo
Lead conversion ko secondary mark karo
mr: Conversion window 1 दिवसाची करा
Attribution last click वर करा
Lead conversion ची counting 'One' per click करा
Lead conversion secondary म्हणून mark करा

exp.en: For leads, counting 'One' records only one conversion per ad click, so repeat form submissions don't inflate numbers. 'Every' suits purchases.
exp.hi: Leads ke liye 'One' counting har ad click pe sirf ek conversion record karti hai, isliye baar-baar form bharne se numbers inflate nahi hote. 'Every' purchases ke liye sahi hai.
exp.mr: Leads साठी 'One' counting प्रत्येक ad click मागे एकच conversion नोंदवते, त्यामुळे वारंवार form भरल्याने आकडे फुगत नाहीत. 'Every' हे purchases साठी योग्य आहे.

q.en: A Goa resort's keyword 'beach villa with private pool Goa' has Quality Score 3, with 'Below average' landing page experience. Ads go to a slow homepage. Best fix?
q.hi: Goa ke ek resort ke keyword 'beach villa with private pool Goa' ka Quality Score 3 hai, landing page experience 'Below average'. Ads slow homepage pe jaate hain. Best fix?
q.mr: गोव्यातील एका resort च्या 'beach villa with private pool Goa' keyword चा Quality Score 3 आहे, landing page experience 'Below average'. जाहिराती slow homepage वर जातात. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Raise the bid until Quality Score improves
Add the keyword ten times in the ad headlines
Change the keyword to broad match
Send traffic to a fast, mobile-friendly private-pool villa page
hi: Quality Score sudharne tak bid badhao
Ad headlines mein keyword das baar daalo
Keyword ko broad match kar do
Traffic ko fast, mobile-friendly private-pool villa page pe bhejo
mr: Quality Score सुधारेपर्यंत bid वाढवा
Ad headlines मध्ये keyword दहा वेळा टाका
Keyword broad match करा
Traffic जलद, mobile-friendly private-pool villa page वर पाठवा

exp.en: Landing page experience improves when the page matches the searcher's intent and loads fast on mobile. Bids don't raise Quality Score, and stuffing keywords hurts ad quality.
exp.hi: Landing page experience tab sudharta hai jab page searcher ke intent se match kare aur mobile pe fast load ho. Bid se Quality Score nahi badhta, aur keyword stuffing ad quality bigaadti hai.
exp.mr: Page searcher च्या intent शी जुळले आणि mobile वर जलद load झाले तर landing page experience सुधारतो. Bid ने Quality Score वाढत नाही, आणि keyword stuffing ने ad quality बिघडते.

q.en: A manager changes a campaign's Target CPA by about 30% every day based on yesterday's results. Performance is erratic. What's the best advice?
q.hi: Ek manager kal ke results dekhkar roz campaign ka Target CPA lagbhag 30% badal deta hai. Performance erratic hai. Best advice kya hai?
q.mr: एक manager कालच्या निकालांवरून दररोज campaign चा Target CPA सुमारे 30% बदलतो. Performance अस्थिर आहे. सर्वोत्तम सल्ला कोणता?

en: Make smaller, less frequent changes and judge over longer periods
Change it every hour instead for faster learning
Switch to a new campaign every week
Pause the campaign on low-conversion days
hi: Chhote aur kam frequent changes karo aur lambe period pe judge karo
Tez learning ke liye har ghante badlo
Har hafte naya campaign banao
Kam conversion wale din campaign pause karo
mr: लहान आणि कमी वेळा बदल करा आणि दीर्घ कालावधीवर मूल्यमापन करा
जलद शिकण्यासाठी दर तासाला बदला
दर आठवड्याला नवी campaign सुरू करा
कमी conversion च्या दिवशी campaign pause करा

exp.en: Big, frequent target changes keep Smart Bidding re-adjusting and daily data is noisy. Make gradual changes and evaluate over weeks, accounting for conversion delays.
exp.hi: Bade aur baar-baar target changes Smart Bidding ko lagataar re-adjust karwate hain, aur daily data noisy hota hai. Dheere changes karo aur hafton ke data pe judge karo, conversion delay dhyan mein rakho.
exp.mr: मोठे आणि वारंवार target बदल Smart Bidding ला सतत re-adjust करायला लावतात, आणि दैनिक data गोंधळाचा असतो. हळूहळू बदल करा आणि conversion delay लक्षात घेऊन आठवड्यांच्या data वर मूल्यमापन करा.

q.en: A D2C brand's Performance Max shows 9x ROAS, but search insights reveal much of its spend goes to searches for the brand's own name. Best fix?
q.hi: Ek D2C brand ka Performance Max 9x ROAS dikhata hai, par search insights batate hain ki kaafi spend brand ke apne naam ki searches pe ja raha hai. Best fix?
q.mr: एका D2C brand चा Performance Max 9x ROAS दाखवतो, पण search insights नुसार बराच खर्च brand च्याच नावाच्या searches वर जात आहे. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Raise Target ROAS to 15x
Apply brand exclusions in PMax and cover brand in a separate Search campaign
Remove all product images from asset groups
Increase the PMax budget since ROAS is high
hi: Target ROAS 15x kar do
PMax mein brand exclusions lagao aur brand ko alag Search campaign mein cover karo
Asset groups se saari product images hata do
ROAS high hai to PMax budget badhao
mr: Target ROAS 15x करा
PMax मध्ये brand exclusions लावा आणि brand वेगळ्या Search campaign मध्ये चालवा
Asset groups मधून सगळ्या product images काढा
ROAS जास्त आहे म्हणून PMax budget वाढवा

exp.en: Brand searchers would often buy anyway, so brand traffic inflates PMax ROAS. Brand exclusions push PMax toward new demand, while a Search campaign handles brand with clear reporting.
exp.hi: Brand search karne wale aksar waise bhi khareed lete, isliye brand traffic PMax ka ROAS inflate karta hai. Brand exclusions PMax ko nayi demand ki taraf dhakelte hain, aur Search campaign brand ko clear reporting ke saath handle karta hai.
exp.mr: Brand शोधणारे बहुतेकदा तसेही खरेदी करतात, म्हणून brand traffic मुळे PMax चा ROAS फुगतो. Brand exclusions PMax ला नव्या demand कडे वळवतात, आणि Search campaign brand स्पष्ट reporting सह हाताळते.

q.en: What is the main risk of using Target impression share bidding at 100% 'absolute top of page' without a max CPC limit?
q.hi: Target impression share bidding ko 100% 'absolute top of page' pe bina max CPC limit ke use karne ka main risk kya hai?
q.mr: Target impression share bidding 100% 'absolute top of page' वर max CPC limit शिवाय वापरण्याचा मुख्य धोका कोणता?

en: Ads will only show on the Display Network
Quality Score drops to 1 automatically
CPCs can climb very high because it chases visibility, not conversions
Google will stop counting impressions
hi: Ads sirf Display Network pe dikhenge
Quality Score automatically 1 ho jayega
CPC bahut upar ja sakta hai kyunki yeh conversions nahi, visibility ke peeche bhaagta hai
Google impressions count karna band kar dega
mr: जाहिराती फक्त Display Network वर दिसतील
Quality Score आपोआप 1 होईल
CPC खूप वाढू शकतो कारण ही strategy conversions नव्हे तर visibility मागे धावते
Google impressions मोजणे थांबवेल

exp.en: Target impression share optimizes for visibility, so an aggressive target can push bids very high regardless of conversions. Setting a max CPC bid limit caps that risk.
exp.hi: Target impression share visibility ke liye optimize karta hai, isliye aggressive target conversions ki parwah kiye bina bids bahut badha sakta hai. Max CPC bid limit isko cap karti hai.
exp.mr: Target impression share visibility साठी optimize करते, त्यामुळे आक्रमक target conversions चा विचार न करता bids खूप वाढवू शकतो. Max CPC bid limit हा धोका मर्यादित करते.

q.en: In Performance Max, what does the new customer acquisition goal set to 'bid higher for new customers' do?
q.hi: Performance Max mein new customer acquisition goal ko 'bid higher for new customers' pe set karne se kya hota hai?
q.mr: Performance Max मध्ये new customer acquisition goal 'bid higher for new customers' वर ठेवल्यास काय होते?

en: Excludes all past website visitors from ads
Gives new customers an automatic discount
Shows ads only in cities you haven't targeted before
Values new-customer conversions more, using your customer lists or data
hi: Saare purane website visitors ko ads se exclude karta hai
Naye customers ko automatic discount deta hai
Sirf un cities mein ads dikhata hai jo pehle target nahi ki
Customer lists/data use karke new-customer conversions ko zyada value deta hai
mr: सर्व जुन्या website visitors ना जाहिरातींमधून वगळते
नव्या customers ना आपोआप discount देते
आधी target न केलेल्या शहरांतच जाहिराती दाखवते
Customer lists/data वापरून new-customer conversions ना जास्त value देते

exp.en: The goal uses your customer lists and conversion data to spot new vs existing customers and bids more for new ones by adding extra value. It doesn't give discounts or exclude all past visitors.
exp.hi: Yeh goal customer lists aur conversion data se naye vs existing customers pehchaanta hai aur naye customers ke liye extra value jodkar zyada bid karta hai. Discount ya saare visitors exclude nahi karta.
exp.mr: हा goal customer lists आणि conversion data वरून नवे vs जुने customers ओळखतो आणि नव्या customers साठी extra value जोडून जास्त bid करतो. तो discount देत नाही किंवा सगळे visitors वगळत नाही.

q.en: Your campaign's average daily budget is ₹1,000, but Google spent ₹1,900 on one day. What's true?
q.hi: Campaign ka average daily budget ₹1,000 hai, par Google ne ek din ₹1,900 kharch kar diye. Kya sach hai?
q.mr: Campaign चे average daily budget ₹1,000 आहे, पण Google ने एका दिवशी ₹1,900 खर्च केले. काय खरे आहे?

en: Normal: daily spend can reach 2x, but monthly charges stay within ~30.4x daily budget
It's a billing error and will be fully refunded automatically
Your budget was hacked; change your password
Google will charge ₹1,900 every day from now on
hi: Normal: daily spend 2x tak ja sakta hai, par monthly charge ~30.4x daily budget ke andar rehta hai
Billing error hai, poora automatically refund hoga
Budget hack hua; password badlo
Ab se Google roz ₹1,900 charge karega
mr: सामान्य: दैनिक खर्च 2x पर्यंत जाऊ शकतो, पण monthly charge ~30.4x daily budget च्या आत राहतो
Billing error आहे, पूर्ण रक्कम आपोआप परत मिळेल
Budget hack झाले; password बदला
आतापासून Google दररोज ₹1,900 घेईल

exp.en: Google may spend up to 2x your average daily budget on high-traffic days, but over a month you won't be charged more than about 30.4 times the daily budget.
exp.hi: High-traffic dinon mein Google average daily budget ka 2x tak kharch kar sakta hai, par mahine mein daily budget ke lagbhag 30.4 guna se zyada charge nahi hota.
exp.mr: जास्त traffic च्या दिवशी Google average daily budget च्या 2x पर्यंत खर्च करू शकते, पण महिन्यात daily budget च्या सुमारे 30.4 पटांपेक्षा जास्त charge लागत नाही.

q.en: A D2C skincare brand's last-click reports show its YouTube/Demand Gen campaigns get almost no conversions, so the CFO wants to cut them. Branded searches rose after they launched. Best move?
q.hi: Ek D2C skincare brand ki last-click reports mein YouTube/Demand Gen campaigns ke almost zero conversions hain, isliye CFO unhe band karna chahta hai. Launch ke baad branded searches badhi. Best move?
q.mr: एका D2C skincare brand च्या last-click reports मध्ये YouTube/Demand Gen campaigns चे जवळपास शून्य conversions आहेत, म्हणून CFO त्या बंद करू इच्छितो. सुरू झाल्यानंतर branded searches वाढल्या. सर्वोत्तम पाऊल?

en: Cut them immediately since last click shows no sales
Run a lift/geo test and check data-driven attribution before deciding
Move the whole budget into brand search
Double the video budget without any measurement
hi: Turant band karo kyunki last click mein sales nahi
Decide karne se pehle lift/geo test chalao aur data-driven attribution dekho
Poora budget brand search mein daal do
Bina measurement ke video budget double karo
mr: Last click मध्ये sales नाहीत म्हणून लगेच बंद करा
निर्णयापूर्वी lift/geo test चालवा आणि data-driven attribution तपासा
संपूर्ण budget brand search मध्ये टाका
कोणतेही मोजमाप न करता video budget दुप्पट करा

exp.en: Upper-funnel video often drives later branded searches that last click credits to Search. A lift or geo test (plus data-driven attribution) shows the true incremental impact before cutting.
exp.hi: Upper-funnel video aksar baad ki branded searches chalata hai jinka credit last click Search ko deta hai. Lift ya geo test (aur data-driven attribution) cut karne se pehle asli incremental impact dikhata hai.
exp.mr: Upper-funnel video अनेकदा नंतरच्या branded searches घडवतो, ज्यांचे श्रेय last click Search ला देते. Lift किंवा geo test (आणि data-driven attribution) बंद करण्यापूर्वी खरा incremental परिणाम दाखवतो.

q.en: A B2B machinery firm imports offline conversions: raw leads, qualified leads and closed deals. Deal sizes vary hugely. It wants bidding to chase revenue, not lead count. Best setup?
q.hi: Ek B2B machinery firm offline conversions import karti hai: raw leads, qualified leads aur closed deals. Deal sizes mein bahut farak hai. Bidding ko lead count nahi, revenue ke peeche bhagana hai. Best setup?
q.mr: एक B2B machinery firm offline conversions import करते: raw leads, qualified leads आणि closed deals. Deal sizes मध्ये खूप फरक आहे. Bidding ने lead count नव्हे तर revenue मागे धावावे. सर्वोत्तम setup?

en: Give every stage the same value and use Maximize clicks
Keep only raw leads as primary with Target CPA
Assign values by stage/deal size and use Maximize conversion value or Target ROAS
Stop importing offline data to avoid confusion
hi: Har stage ko same value do aur Maximize clicks use karo
Sirf raw leads ko primary rakho Target CPA ke saath
Stage/deal size ke hisaab se values do aur Maximize conversion value ya Target ROAS use karo
Confusion se bachne ke liye offline data import band karo
mr: प्रत्येक stage ला समान value द्या आणि Maximize clicks वापरा
फक्त raw leads primary ठेवा Target CPA सह
Stage/deal size नुसार values द्या आणि Maximize conversion value किंवा Target ROAS वापरा
गोंधळ टाळण्यासाठी offline data import बंद करा

exp.en: Value-based bidding needs values that reflect business worth. Weighting deeper stages and bigger deals lets Maximize conversion value/Target ROAS chase revenue instead of cheap leads.
exp.hi: Value-based bidding ko business worth dikhane wali values chahiye. Deeper stages aur bade deals ko zyada value dene se Maximize conversion value/Target ROAS saste leads nahi, revenue ke peeche jaata hai.
exp.mr: Value-based bidding ला व्यवसायाचे खरे मूल्य दाखवणाऱ्या values लागतात. पुढच्या stages आणि मोठ्या deals ना जास्त value दिल्यास Maximize conversion value/Target ROAS स्वस्त leads नव्हे तर revenue मागे जाते.

q.en: A Chennai AC-repair campaign has CPA well below target and steady profit. Search lost IS (budget) is 55% and lost IS (rank) is 5%. Best next step?
q.hi: Chennai ke ek AC-repair campaign ka CPA target se kaafi kam hai aur profit steady hai. Search lost IS (budget) 55% aur lost IS (rank) 5% hai. Best next step?
q.mr: चेन्नईच्या एका AC-repair campaign चा CPA target पेक्षा खूप कमी आहे आणि नफा स्थिर आहे. Search lost IS (budget) 55% आणि lost IS (rank) 5% आहे. पुढची सर्वोत्तम पायरी?

en: Raise bids sharply to fix the rank problem
Rewrite ads to improve Quality Score first
Pause half the keywords to save money
Increase the budget to capture the profitable demand you're missing
hi: Rank problem fix karne ke liye bids tezi se badhao
Pehle Quality Score sudharne ke liye ads dobara likho
Paisa bachane ke liye aadhe keywords pause karo
Budget badhao taaki miss ho rahi profitable demand capture ho
mr: Rank समस्या सोडवण्यासाठी bids झपाट्याने वाढवा
आधी Quality Score सुधारण्यासाठी ads पुन्हा लिहा
पैसे वाचवण्यासाठी अर्धे keywords pause करा
गमावत असलेली फायदेशीर demand मिळवण्यासाठी budget वाढवा

exp.en: Most lost impressions are due to budget, not rank, and the campaign is profitable. Adding budget captures more of that demand; raising bids would mostly just raise CPCs.
exp.hi: Zyadatar impressions budget ki wajah se miss ho rahe hain, rank se nahi, aur campaign profitable hai. Budget badhane se woh demand milegi; bids badhane se mostly CPC hi badhega.
exp.mr: बहुतेक impressions budget मुळे गमावले जात आहेत, rank मुळे नाही, आणि campaign फायदेशीर आहे. Budget वाढवल्यास ती demand मिळेल; bids वाढवल्यास मुख्यतः CPC च वाढेल.

q.en: A B2B HR-software company wants search ads that favour people in HR roles at mid-size companies. Which platform feature fits best?
q.hi: Ek B2B HR-software company chahti hai ki search ads mid-size companies mein HR roles wale logon ko prefer karein. Kaunsa platform feature best fit hai?
q.mr: एका B2B HR-software company ला mid-size companies मधील HR roles मधल्या लोकांना प्राधान्य देणाऱ्या search ads हव्या आहेत. कोणते platform feature सर्वात योग्य?

en: Microsoft Advertising's LinkedIn profile targeting
Google Merchant Center product feeds
Google Ads location 'Presence' option
YouTube bumper ads
hi: Microsoft Advertising ka LinkedIn profile targeting
Google Merchant Center product feeds
Google Ads ka location 'Presence' option
YouTube bumper ads
mr: Microsoft Advertising चे LinkedIn profile targeting
Google Merchant Center product feeds
Google Ads चा location 'Presence' option
YouTube bumper ads

exp.en: Microsoft Advertising can use LinkedIn profile data (company, industry, job function) to target or adjust bids on search ads, which is useful for B2B.
exp.hi: Microsoft Advertising search ads ke liye LinkedIn profile data (company, industry, job function) se targeting ya bid adjustment kar sakta hai, jo B2B ke liye useful hai.
exp.mr: Microsoft Advertising search ads साठी LinkedIn profile data (company, industry, job function) वापरून targeting किंवा bid adjustment करू शकते, जे B2B साठी उपयुक्त आहे.

q.en: An electronics D2C store uses Target ROAS on revenue. Phones have 8% margin and accessories 50%, so the account shows good ROAS but thin profit. Best strategic fix?
q.hi: Ek electronics D2C store revenue pe Target ROAS use karta hai. Phones ka margin 8% aur accessories ka 50% hai, isliye account mein ROAS accha par profit kam hai. Best strategic fix?
q.mr: एक electronics D2C store revenue वर Target ROAS वापरते. Phones चा margin 8% आणि accessories चा 50% आहे, त्यामुळे account मध्ये ROAS चांगला पण नफा कमी आहे. सर्वोत्तम strategic उपाय?

en: Raise the Target ROAS for the whole account
Optimize to profit: send margin-based values or split by margin with separate targets
Stop selling phones on Google entirely
Switch to Maximize clicks to cut CPC
hi: Poore account ka Target ROAS badhao
Profit pe optimize karo: margin-based values bhejo ya margin ke hisaab se split karke alag targets do
Google pe phones bechna bilkul band karo
CPC kam karne ke liye Maximize clicks pe jao
mr: संपूर्ण account चा Target ROAS वाढवा
नफ्यावर optimize करा: margin-based values पाठवा किंवा margin नुसार विभागून वेगळे targets द्या
Google वर phones विकणे पूर्ण बंद करा
CPC कमी करण्यासाठी Maximize clicks वर जा

exp.en: Revenue ROAS treats ₹1 of phone sales like ₹1 of accessory sales. Passing profit-based values, or splitting products by margin with their own targets, makes bidding chase profit.
exp.hi: Revenue ROAS phone ke ₹1 aur accessory ke ₹1 ko barabar maanta hai. Profit-based values bhejne ya margin ke hisaab se products split karke alag targets dene se bidding profit ke peeche jaati hai.
exp.mr: Revenue ROAS phone चा ₹1 आणि accessory चा ₹1 सारखाच मानतो. Profit-based values पाठवणे किंवा margin नुसार products विभागून वेगळे targets देणे यामुळे bidding नफ्यामागे जाते.

q.en: A campaign mixing brand and non-brand keywords shows 12x ROAS. Split out, brand is 30x but non-brand is 1.5x, below the 2.5x break-even. Best move?
q.hi: Brand aur non-brand keywords mix wala campaign 12x ROAS dikhata hai. Alag karne pe brand 30x hai par non-brand 1.5x, jo 2.5x break-even se neeche hai. Best move?
q.mr: Brand आणि non-brand keywords एकत्र असलेली campaign 12x ROAS दाखवते. वेगळे केल्यावर brand 30x पण non-brand 1.5x आहे, जो 2.5x break-even पेक्षा कमी आहे. सर्वोत्तम पाऊल?

en: Keep them together since blended ROAS is great
Pause brand keywords because they look too good
Split into separate campaigns with their own targets and fix non-brand
Double the combined budget to scale the 12x
hi: Saath rakho kyunki blended ROAS badhiya hai
Brand keywords pause karo kyunki bahut acche lag rahe hain
Alag campaigns banao apne targets ke saath aur non-brand ko fix karo
12x ko scale karne ke liye combined budget double karo
mr: एकत्रच ठेवा कारण blended ROAS उत्तम आहे
Brand keywords pause करा कारण ते खूपच चांगले दिसतात
स्वतःच्या targets सह वेगळ्या campaigns बनवा आणि non-brand सुधारा
12x scale करण्यासाठी combined budget दुप्पट करा

exp.en: Blended ROAS hides loss-making non-brand spend behind cheap brand conversions. Separating them allows proper targets and budgets, and shows where to fix non-brand.
exp.hi: Blended ROAS saste brand conversions ke peeche nuksaan wala non-brand spend chhupa deta hai. Alag karne se sahi targets aur budgets set hote hain, aur non-brand mein kya fix karna hai woh dikhta hai.
exp.mr: Blended ROAS स्वस्त brand conversions च्या आड तोट्यातील non-brand खर्च लपवतो. वेगळे केल्याने योग्य targets व budgets ठरवता येतात आणि non-brand मध्ये काय सुधारायचे ते दिसते.

q.en: A SaaS startup has ₹30,000/month. Expected CPC is ~₹150 and conversion rate ~2%, i.e. about 4 sign-ups a month. The founder wants to test Search, Display, YouTube and PMax at once. Best advice?
q.hi: Ek SaaS startup ke paas ₹30,000/month hai. Expected CPC ~₹150 aur conversion rate ~2%, yaani mahine mein lagbhag 4 sign-ups. Founder Search, Display, YouTube aur PMax ek saath test karna chahta hai. Best advice?
q.mr: एका SaaS startup कडे ₹30,000/महिना आहेत. अपेक्षित CPC ~₹150 आणि conversion rate ~2%, म्हणजे महिन्याला सुमारे 4 sign-ups. Founder ला Search, Display, YouTube आणि PMax एकाच वेळी test करायचे आहेत. सर्वोत्तम सल्ला?

en: Split the budget equally across all four channels
Set Target CPA at ₹1,000 from day one
Use 200 broad match keywords to find more volume
Focus on a few high-intent keywords in one Search campaign and track micro-conversions
hi: Budget chaaron channels mein barabar baanto
Pehle din se Target CPA ₹1,000 set karo
Zyada volume ke liye 200 broad match keywords use karo
Ek Search campaign mein kuch high-intent keywords pe focus karo aur micro-conversions track karo
mr: Budget चारही channels मध्ये समान वाटा
पहिल्या दिवसापासून Target CPA ₹1,000 ठेवा
जास्त volume साठी 200 broad match keywords वापरा
एका Search campaign मध्ये काही high-intent keywords वर लक्ष द्या आणि micro-conversions track करा

exp.en: ₹30,000 ÷ ₹150 ≈ 200 clicks × 2% ≈ 4 conversions. Split four ways, no channel gets enough data. Concentrate on high-intent search and track micro-conversions to learn faster.
exp.hi: ₹30,000 ÷ ₹150 ≈ 200 clicks × 2% ≈ 4 conversions. Chaar jagah baantne se kisi channel ko enough data nahi milega. High-intent search pe focus karo aur micro-conversions track karo taaki jaldi seekho.
exp.mr: ₹30,000 ÷ ₹150 ≈ 200 clicks × 2% ≈ 4 conversions. चार ठिकाणी वाटल्यास कोणत्याही channel ला पुरेसा data मिळणार नाही. High-intent search वर लक्ष द्या आणि लवकर शिकण्यासाठी micro-conversions track करा.

q.en: Why might Google Ads show fractional conversions like 12.4 for a keyword?
q.hi: Google Ads kisi keyword ke liye 12.4 jaise fractional conversions kyun dikha sakta hai?
q.mr: Google Ads एखाद्या keyword साठी 12.4 सारखे fractional conversions का दाखवू शकते?

en: Data-driven attribution splits credit across several ad interactions
Some users converted on two devices at once
Google rounds conversions to save storage
Invalid clicks are subtracted as decimals
hi: Data-driven attribution credit ko kai ad interactions mein baant-ta hai
Kuch users ne ek saath do devices pe convert kiya
Storage bachane ke liye Google conversions round karta hai
Invalid clicks decimals mein minus hote hain
mr: Data-driven attribution श्रेय अनेक ad interactions मध्ये वाटते
काही users नी एकाच वेळी दोन devices वर convert केले
Storage वाचवण्यासाठी Google conversions round करते
Invalid clicks decimals मध्ये वजा होतात

exp.en: With data-driven attribution, one conversion's credit is shared across the clicks and interactions that contributed, so keywords receive fractions. Smart Bidding uses this credit too.
exp.hi: Data-driven attribution mein ek conversion ka credit un saare clicks/interactions mein baant-ta hai jinhone contribute kiya, isliye keywords ko fractions milte hain. Smart Bidding bhi yahi credit use karti hai.
exp.mr: Data-driven attribution मध्ये एका conversion चे श्रेय योगदान दिलेल्या सर्व clicks/interactions मध्ये वाटले जाते, म्हणून keywords ना अपूर्णांक मिळतात. Smart Bidding सुद्धा हेच श्रेय वापरते.

q.en: A Mumbai home-loan advisor knows leads from Mumbai close 3x more often than leads from elsewhere. Which Google Ads feature lets value-based bidding reflect this without changing the tag?
q.hi: Mumbai ke ek home-loan advisor ko pata hai ki Mumbai ke leads baaki jagah ke leads se 3x zyada close hote hain. Kaunsa Google Ads feature bina tag badle value-based bidding mein yeh reflect karta hai?
q.mr: मुंबईच्या एका home-loan advisor ला माहीत आहे की मुंबईचे leads इतर ठिकाणच्या leads पेक्षा 3x जास्त close होतात. Tag न बदलता value-based bidding मध्ये हे दाखवणारे Google Ads feature कोणते?

en: Location bid adjustments on Maximize clicks
Conversion value rules
Ad schedule
Callout assets
hi: Maximize clicks pe location bid adjustments
Conversion value rules
Ad schedule
Callout assets
mr: Maximize clicks वर location bid adjustments
Conversion value rules
Ad schedule
Callout assets

exp.en: Conversion value rules adjust conversion values by location, audience or device in real time, so Target ROAS or Maximize conversion value bids more where leads are worth more.
exp.hi: Conversion value rules location, audience ya device ke hisaab se conversion values real time mein adjust karte hain, taaki Target ROAS ya Maximize conversion value wahan zyada bid kare jahan leads zyada valuable hain.
exp.mr: Conversion value rules location, audience किंवा device नुसार conversion values real time मध्ये बदलतात, त्यामुळे Target ROAS किंवा Maximize conversion value जिथे leads जास्त मौल्यवान तिथे जास्त bid करतात.

q.en: After launching Performance Max, an agency reports 900 PMax conversions in a quarter. Yet total business conversions rose by only about 200, and brand Search and remarketing conversions fell. Most likely explanation?
q.hi: Performance Max launch ke baad agency ek quarter mein 900 PMax conversions report karti hai. Par total business conversions sirf lagbhag 200 badhe, aur brand Search aur remarketing conversions gire. Sabse likely explanation?
q.mr: Performance Max सुरू केल्यानंतर agency एका quarter मध्ये 900 PMax conversions report करते. पण एकूण business conversions फक्त सुमारे 200 ने वाढले, आणि brand Search व remarketing conversions घटले. सर्वात संभाव्य स्पष्टीकरण?

en: The conversion tag is double-counting only brand Search
Business data is wrong; ad platforms are always accurate
PMax is claiming conversions that other campaigns would have got anyway
PMax needs more budget to show its full effect
hi: Conversion tag sirf brand Search ko double-count kar raha hai
Business data galat hai; ad platforms hamesha accurate hote hain
PMax un conversions ka credit le raha hai jo baaki campaigns ko waise bhi milte
PMax ko pura asar dikhane ke liye aur budget chahiye
mr: Conversion tag फक्त brand Search दुप्पट मोजत आहे
Business data चुकीचा आहे; ad platforms नेहमी अचूक असतात
इतर campaigns ना तसेही मिळाले असते त्या conversions चे श्रेय PMax घेत आहे
पूर्ण परिणाम दाखवण्यासाठी PMax ला जास्त budget हवे

exp.en: PMax can serve on brand and remarketing traffic, taking credit for sales that would have happened anyway. Judge by incremental account-level results or experiments, and use brand exclusions.
exp.hi: PMax brand aur remarketing traffic pe bhi serve hota hai aur un sales ka credit le leta hai jo waise bhi hoti. Incremental account-level results ya experiments se judge karo, aur brand exclusions lagao.
exp.mr: PMax brand आणि remarketing traffic वरही serve होतो आणि तसेही झाल्या असत्या अशा sales चे श्रेय घेतो. Incremental account-level निकाल किंवा experiments वरून मूल्यमापन करा आणि brand exclusions वापरा.

q.en: A Hyderabad clinic's campaign on Maximize conversions spends its full ₹5,000/day, but CPA is ₹1,200 against a ₹600 goal. What's the smartest correction?
q.hi: Hyderabad ke ek clinic ka Maximize conversions campaign roz ka pura ₹5,000 kharch karta hai, par CPA ₹1,200 hai jabki goal ₹600 hai. Sabse smart correction kya hai?
q.mr: हैदराबादच्या एका clinic ची Maximize conversions campaign दररोजचे पूर्ण ₹5,000 खर्च करते, पण CPA ₹1,200 आहे आणि goal ₹600 आहे. सर्वात हुशार सुधारणा कोणती?

en: Double the budget so Google finds cheaper conversions
Set Target CPA at ₹600 immediately
Switch to Maximize clicks to lower CPC
Add a Target CPA near the current CPA, lower it gradually, and cut wasteful queries
hi: Budget double karo taaki Google saste conversions dhoondhe
Turant Target CPA ₹600 set karo
CPC kam karne ke liye Maximize clicks pe jao
Current CPA ke paas Target CPA lagao, dheere-dheere kam karo, aur wasteful queries hatao
mr: Google स्वस्त conversions शोधेल म्हणून budget दुप्पट करा
लगेच Target CPA ₹600 ठेवा
CPC कमी करण्यासाठी Maximize clicks वर जा
सध्याच्या CPA जवळ Target CPA ठेवा, हळूहळू कमी करा आणि वाया जाणाऱ्या queries काढा

exp.en: Without a target, Maximize conversions spends the whole budget even at high CPA. A Target CPA near current results, lowered in steps, plus removing waste, improves efficiency without collapsing volume.
exp.hi: Target ke bina Maximize conversions pura budget kharch karta hai chahe CPA zyada ho. Current results ke paas Target CPA, steps mein kam karna, aur waste hatana volume giraye bina efficiency sudharta hai.
exp.mr: Target नसल्यास Maximize conversions CPA जास्त असला तरी पूर्ण budget खर्च करते. सध्याच्या निकालांजवळ Target CPA ठेवून टप्प्याटप्प्याने कमी करणे आणि waste काढणे यामुळे volume न घसरता efficiency सुधारते.
